importantDistinctions: An unspecified instruction to cover all remedies, fees, exceptions and intents is not evidence of a particular missing public answer.
Current missing rendered assignments that already exist in source are delivery work, not fresh research debt.
Queries, rankings, publication and browser checks are evidence tracks, not legal-content questions.
Case-specific application and outside-regime pages are scoped separately; this does not automatically close the page.
The confirmed blocker list is deliberately narrower than the residual research candidate list. No unreviewed candidate is silently declared resolved.
